An '''intrinsic''' is a special ability hidden in an item. For [[food]], it is the status [[effect]] that an [[ingredient]] carries: raw, the ingredient does nothing special, but cooking it "awakens" the intrinsic, and every dish made from it grants the same effect for longer the more work goes into it.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=In Matcha Flavored, most ingredients have special abilities. I call them intrinsics. Cooking an ingredient can awaken whatever intrinsic is hidden in the raw food.}}</ref> [[Pumpkin]], for example, has no effect on its own, but [[Baked Pumpkin|baked pumpkin]] gives {{EffectLink|Resistance}} for {{Value|Baked Pumpkin|duration|effect=Resistance}}, [[Pumpkin Jam|pumpkin jam]] for {{Value|Pumpkin Jam|duration|effect=Resistance}} and a [[Pumpkin Empanada|pumpkin empanada]] for {{Value|Pumpkin Empanada|duration|effect=Resistance}}.

The pack also uses the word for the built-in abilities of equipment, such as the [[Warding|warding]] of silver weapons or the knockback of [[Mattock|mattocks]]. Those are covered on the pages of the equipment and on [[Set bonus]]; this page covers ingredients.

== Mechanics ==
Most intrinsic ingredients have at least three dishes:<ref>{{Cite video|quote=All ingredients with intrinsics have at least three corresponding foods. Simple preparation, preservation, and a meal.}}</ref>
* A '''simple preparation''': the ingredient cooked alone in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. Its effect lasts 3 to 30 seconds, and it mostly tells the player what the ingredient does.
* A '''preservation''': a jam, pickle, can or drink crafted from the ingredient and a [[Glass Bottle|glass bottle]]. Its effect usually lasts 3 to 5 minutes.
* A '''meal''': a crafted dish, which lasts longest and heals the most.

Some ingredients have further dishes, and pumpkin is also the key ingredient of an [[#Oven meals|oven meal]] that lasts 20 minutes. The effect doesn't depend on anything else in the recipe: meat, [[bread]], [[cheese]], [[dough]] and the other base ingredients have no intrinsic, so a dish only gains an effect from its intrinsic ingredients. A few dishes combine two, such as [[lumpia]] ([[carrot]] and [[Dried Kelp|kelp]]) or [[Warped Pizza|warped pizza]] ([[Warped Fungus|warped fungus]] and [[tomatoes]]).

The pack's README counts "12 food ingredients" with intrinsics, and the developer described two more as "secret ingredients" whose foods are hidden from the recipe book.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref><ref>{{Cite video|quote=There are 12 ingredients with unique effects plus two more that act as secret ingredients, a few secret foods and four special meals that have to be cooked in an oven to make.}}</ref> The golden versions of [[Golden Apple|apples]] and [[Golden Carrot|carrots]] are hidden variants of their ingredients.

Two more ingredients with effects:
* [[Pufferfish]] gives {{EffectLink|Conduit Power}}: [[Cooked Pufferfish|cooked pufferfish]] ({{Value|Cooked Pufferfish|duration|effect=Conduit Power|format=clock}}) and [[bokguk]] ({{Value|Bokguk|duration|effect=Conduit Power|format=clock}}). See [[Fish]].
* [[Honey Bottle|Honey]]'s simple preparation and [[bread]] also have the cleansing effect; see [[Food#Effects|Food]].

Ingredients without an intrinsic are used for healing and as bases: [[potato]]es, [[Mushroom|brown mushrooms]], [[egg]]s, [[Wheat Grain|wheat]], [[Nopales|cactus]], [[sugar]] and meat. Brown mushrooms are the pickling agent of every pickle.

== Oven meals ==
There are five oven meals. Each is crafted as a [[stock]] and cooked for 15 seconds, heals {{Hp|20}} and gives the strongest version of its effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/green_curry.json}}</ref>

{| class="wikitable"
! Meal !! Stock !! Intrinsic ingredients in the stock !! Effect
|-
| {{ItemLink|Green Curry}} || [[Green Curry Stock]] || — || {{EffectLink|Speed}} {{Value|Green Curry|level|effect=Speed}} ({{Value|Green Curry|duration|effect=Speed|format=clock}})
|-
| {{ItemLink|Japanese Curry}} || [[Curry Stock]] || [[Carrot]] || {{EffectLink|Strength}} ({{Value|Japanese Curry|duration|effect=Strength|format=clock}})
|-
| {{ItemLink|Paneer Makhani}} || [[Paneer Curry Stock]] || [[Tomatoes]] || {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} ({{Value|Paneer Makhani|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}})
|-
| {{ItemLink|Tonkotsu Ramen}} || [[Ramen Stock]] || [[Dried Kelp|Kelp]] || {{EffectLink|Haste}} {{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|level|effect=Haste}} ({{Value|Tonkotsu Ramen|duration|effect=Haste|format=clock}})
|-
| {{ItemLink|Pumpkin Curry}} || [[Pumpkin Curry Stock]] || [[Baked Pumpkin]], [[carrot]] || {{EffectLink|Resistance}} ({{Value|Pumpkin Curry|duration|effect=Resistance|format=clock}})
|}
Unlike other dishes, the oven meals' effects are set per meal rather than by their ingredients: only pumpkin curry's effect matches an ingredient's intrinsic. Japanese curry contains carrots but gives Strength, paneer makhani contains tomatoes but gives Regeneration, and tonkotsu ramen contains kelp but gives Haste.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/uncooked_curry.json}}</ref>

{{History|
{{History line|0.7-alpha|Preserves and meals now require the cooked ingredient (for example baked apples instead of apples).}}

}}

== Trivia ==
* The developer took the idea of predictable ingredient effects from ''The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild''.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Breath of the Wild had something similar. I love that game.}}</ref>
* The developer's examples of planning with intrinsics: melons before a trip to [[Hell]], glow berries or carrots for caving, and chorus fruit for [[The End]].<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If they're planning a trip to hell, they'll want to find some melons first. If they're caving, they should probably grab some glow berries or carrots.}}</ref>
